title: Patch Notes — July 28, 2026
highlights: Upgrade VFX added for +8, +9, and +10 equipment
NPC and Goblin death animations added without ragdoll for better FPS
Tutorial steps added for targeting and spell casting
Scrap Metal tutorial quest requirement reduced from 5 to 3
Chicken Pet bonus granted after Tutorial Chapter 1 Part 3 with an equip tutorial step
Aurora Wave mana cost per projectile increased by 1.5x
Race Reroll odds normalized to 33.33% per race
Item drops no longer use physics
Damage Contest UI now requires that the player dealt damage and the monster is within render distance
Upgrade cosmetic effect setting changed to a Show/Hide toggle
Premium Shop, Purchase History, Redeemed Codes, Mail, Play Time, Daily Login, Liked Players, Social Likes, and Settings made account-bound
Dewdrop optimized with roughly 4 million triangles removed

title: Combat Cone Follow-up — July 30, 2026
highlights: Attack cone widened from ±20° to ±45° for the next patch

title: Patch Notes — July 30, 2026
highlights: Chapter 2 released
Items now display Bound, Tradeable, or Free status
Aurora Wave reworked: no channeling, charge-up behavior, more bolts, higher damage, explosion around target
Blade Circuit gained more slashes and more damage
Timber Charge damage increased, hit behavior fixed, and it stuns non-demihumans for 1 second
Bosses and mini-bosses can no longer be knocked around
Bash stun and slow duration increased
Heal now scales with Magic Attack
Mana Shield blocks crowd control except Cripple
Long-range attacks against targets far above or below now miss
Junk King HP increased from 35,000 to 1,050,000
Tin Tortoise HP increased from 37,500 to 525,000
Junk King and Tin Tortoise accessory drops made about 25% more common and spirit stones about 2.5x more common
Spirit stone effects can trigger every 1 second instead of every 3 seconds
Build Mode placement grid added
World loot unlocks after completing Working the Land
Quest NPCs can no longer be attacked
Anti-cheat began pulling back speed, jump, and fly exploits

title: Patch Notes — August 3, 2026
highlights: Stuck monsters return to spawn after 2 seconds and are invulnerable while returning
New Enchanter skill Aqua Bloom added as Water-element magic
Premium Pass added
New Door decoration recipe added
Monsters gained elemental attributes
Headgear added to the Codex
Build Mode overlay added with invalid placements shown in red
Fortune Clover, Bone Bite, Tinker's Goggles, and Plague Mask headgear added

title: Patch Notes — August 5, 2026
highlights: Greenhouse became craftable at the Workbench
Maximum 1 Greenhouse per plot by default
Season 1 Premium Pass grants +1 additional permanent Greenhouse slot
Level 20 players received 1 Ultimate Skillbook as compensation
Goblin Claw Machine Ultimate Skillbook changed from Untradeable to Tradeable
Fish and Food assets were reworked
Boss Quest removed from Battle Pass Quest and EXP moved to Mini Boss Quest
Battle Pass +1 Level option (+3000 EXP) added for 15 Robux
Party/Solo Top 1-3 Damage tracking fixed for quests and Codex
Swimming-stuck issue fixed
Second-door usability issue fixed

title: Patch Notes — v1.0.4
highlights: Fixed collision issues that could trap players during repeated Auto Attack near objects
Fixed ladder climbing during Baby Phase
Fixed various Greenhouse bugs
Skills cast without a valid target now consume 50% of normal mana cost

title: Patch Notes — v1.0.5
highlights: Fixed Aqua Bloom skill glitch
Combat Mode changed to trigger when dealing or receiving damage
Some poles made slippery

title: Patch Notes — v1.1.6
highlights: Lycaros added as a Weekly World Boss
HP/MP regeneration formula changed to Base Regen + Bonus Regen
Bonus Regen equals 0.2% of Max HP/MP and is capped at 3% of Max HP/MP
Regeneration multipliers: 50% in combat, 100% out of combat, 150% while sitting
Body Slam added for Defender
Tailwind added for Enchanter
Blade Rush added for Warrior
Doombell added for Cleric
Whirlwind changed to scale with DEF instead of PATK and scaling increased from 100% to 400%
Aqua Bloom damage formula fixed and rebalanced
Dewdrop Ore Nodes increased from 20 to 35
Identify system added for Shoes, Gloves, Bracelet, Necklace, and Upper/Middle/Lower Headgear
Magnifying Glasses used for Identify are dropped by Lycaros

title: Patch Notes — v1.1.7
highlights: Lycaros weekly schedule listed as Saturday 16:00 and 04:00 GMT+7
Body Slam, Tailwind, and Blade Rush listed as new skills
Identify system uses Magnifying Glasses dropped by Lycaros
Part-Time Jobs added for Breda, Eren, Neria, Leaf, Arlette, and Hogan while those NPCs are sleeping

title: Update & Patch Notes v1.1.8
highlights: Lycaros Prize Pool UI fixes
Forge UI fixes
Player interaction now only triggers while sheathed
Timber Charge grants CC immunity during use; deferred CC applies afterward
Timber Charge vs Timber Charge remains an exception
Additional Quick Slots unlock after clearing Chapter 2
Skill VFX Filter settings added: Self, Party, Everyone
World Motion graphics toggle added

title: Patch Notes — v1.1.9
highlights: Fixed Dual Wield elemental effects
Fixed Slider UI issues on PC and Mobile
Fixed SFX volume slider
Fixed skill-spam issue during Part-Time Jobs

title: Patch Notes — v1.1.10
highlights: Junk King and Tin Tortoise can now drop Magnifying Glass
Claw Machine stuck protection guarantees 1 Goblin Coin when stuck with no reward
Claw Machine now displays reward probability chances
Claw Machine can be restocked
Server Hop filters added for All, Friends, and Filter by Name

title: Patch Notes — v1.1.12
timestampContext: Discord displayed only the time because the post was from the viewer's current day. Date resolved using the site owner's local date; the 02:05 clock time is the site owner's Discord display timezone and should not be interpreted as the developer's timezone.
highlights: Players can equip only one title at a time
Fixed false bans caused by physics flings
Auto Jump disabled
All attacks now trigger Combat Mode
Fortune Clover and Bone Bite made tradable
Fixed Resurrect target selection
Pet pathfinding fixed
Pet collision disabled
Cart collision disabled

title: Patch Notes — v1.2.13
source: Official Discord big-update announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-20
highlights: Guild System opened
Guilds are created through Rendall for 499 Robux
Guilds start with capacity for 15 members and can be upgraded to a maximum of 30
Arcane Defense is available every Friday and must be started by the Guild Leader
The Event Calendar displays Lycaros' schedule in the player's local time
Qualified Lycaros fighters receive 2 Magnifying Glass, 3 Goblin Coin, 3,500 Tria, and 300 Guild EXP
Lycaros base Prize Pool increased from 6 prizes to 10 prizes
Top 1, Top 2, and Top 3 damage contributors receive 5, 3, and 2 additional Magnifying Glass respectively, randomly distributed among party members
Magnifying Glass added to the Claw Machine prize pool
Maximum Damage Up cap increased from 100% to 120%
Network transmission improvements reduce unnecessary data usage and improve overall network performance

title: Guild & Arcane Defense — Reward System
highlights: The Guild Leader must start Arcane Defense manually
Offering 10 Materials grants 300 Guild EXP and 1 Guild Coin
Every 1,000 Tria contributed each day grants 300 Guild EXP and 1 Guild Coin
Each completed Arcane Defense wave grants 300 Guild EXP, 1 Guild Coin, wave-specific Tria, and a wave-specific additional reward
Each Guild member qualified for Lycaros rewards grants 300 Guild EXP to the Guild reward context
Players can donate decorations to the Guild and use them collaboratively to build the Guild Base
The official Arcane Defense chart documents rewards for waves 1–50

title: Patch Notes — v1.2.14
source: Official Discord patch announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-24
highlights: Overall monster movement speed adjusted
Arcane Defense monster base stats reduced and no longer scale; elements still follow the Wave Table; Max HP scaling changed from Exponential to Linear
Arcane Defense Leaderboard added
A second Lycaros attempt now contributes to Codex progress, grants half participant rewards only, and can award the Lycaros Undertaker title
Fixed Lycaros getting stuck or falling through the ground
Crop Mutation VFX now follows VFX Settings; when multiple mutations are active, only the highest-multiplier mutation VFX is displayed
Mount actions added: Horse Leap and Junkcycle Nitro
Block cap increased from 35% to 50%, Ignore DEF cap from 50% to 70%, and Damage Up cap from 120% to 150%
Punk Lamb's Level 20 Damage Bonus increased from 10% to 15%
Item Details now display buff stacking information and the HP Bar displays active status effects
Guild Leaders can create private or public servers in Dewdrop Village
